When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.

Repeat.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Endless One from your library.
Repeat.

Each opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to sacrifice Bronze Bombshell.

Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling It That Betrays and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Sacrifice Bronze Bombshell by any method, triggering each It That Betrays controlled by an opponent.
Resolve one of the It the Betrays triggers, causing an opponent to put Bronze Bombshell from your graveyard onto the battlefield under their control.
Bronze Bombshell triggers, causing its controller to sacrifice it and dealing 7 damage to its controller.
Each It That Betrays not controlled by Bronze Bombshell's controller triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica.
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-1772-3861.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.

Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Rendclaw Trow from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
